blunt.wound: a single heavy blow to the back of the head

knife.wound: one narrow wound under the ribs, clean and deep
weapons: a letter opener with a bone handle

strangle.wound: ligature marks around the neck, no other injuries

poison.wound: no wound at all: blue lips, a cold cup of tea, a faint smell of almonds

grudge.label: an old grudge
things: a fence line they had fought over for six years
a loan that was never repaid
an insult at the Grange dinner that was never forgiven
a dog that kept getting into the garden
a tree that kept dropping on the other side

money.label: money
things: a debt of $4,000 they could not pay
a shared till that was short
an inheritance dispute with a cousin
a business partnership that had gone sour

family.label: inheritance
things: the victim was rewriting the will
the victim planned to sell the family house
the victim was about to cut them out of the estate

silence.label: a secret
things: the victim had learned about the skimming from the Grange fund
the victim had seen a hit-and-run in 2019 and finally decided to talk
the victim found out about a second family in the next county
the victim had found the old census with a page torn out

passion.label: jealousy
things: the victim was leaving them for someone else
the victim had refused them, again, in front of the whole diner
the victim had ended it by letter that morning

dropped: one earring, still warm to the touch
a strand of red wool tied in a knot
a key fob with a fish on it
a pipe cleaner twisted into a ring
shoes: work boots, size 11, with a cracked left heel
narrow loafers with a leather sole worn on the outside
rubber waders, size 9, with a diamond tread
heavy hiking boots with a missing lug on the right

affair.text: was with {p} that night, in secret
affair.why: the affair is a secret in a small town

gambling.text: was in the back room of the Low Water after closing, losing money at cards
gambling.why: they are ashamed of the gambling

vigil.text: was at the lake shore with the others, at the midnight vigil, standing in the water
vigil.why: no one is allowed to say what the vigil is for

burglary.text: was breaking into the Grange hall to take back something that had been theirs

work: The phone and the appointment book

alibi_places.clinic: sitting up at the clinic with a sick relative
alibi_places.low_water: at the Low Water until close, then walking home slowly
alibi_places.pink_heron: washing up at the Pink Heron after the late rush
